scope: Public HTTPS UI with disposable synthetic account/record and real MFA. One record GET intentionally returns 503 via browser interception; repeated click must retry and show the report. No model requests, no PDF assertion in this targeted check.
diagnosticLimits: Normal history links and existing ended-record shapes rendered during investigation. The initiating failure on the user browser was not observed; the same-hash retry dead end was reproduced deterministically and fixed. Unknown report usage reconciliation is a separate unresolved incident.
